meta.description: Exact-commit re-audit after forest/funnel reliability and workflow corrections.
meta.execution_note: Structural wrapper PASS; 13/13 exact-source contract checks PASS; R 4.4.3 data-visualization wrapper executed the full shipped example with warnings promoted to errors. Real BCG and bundled LDL-C/CHD data, plus labelled synthetic Cox and small-k cases, were used. BCG forest and funnel PNGs were inspected.

scientific_integrity.detail: Examples distinguish real bundled data from labelled synthetic demonstrations and make no fabricated claims.

practice_boundaries.detail: The guidance is analytical and explicitly avoids treatment, publication-bias, effect-modification, and causal overclaims.

methodological_ground.detail: REML/log ratios, HKSJ and small-k restraint, k>=10 Egger guard, sensitivity-only trim-and-fill, formal interaction testing, and MR triangulation are methodologically grounded.

code_usability.detail: The full shipped R example completed and produced all five expected visual artifacts with warnings treated as errors.

functional_suitability.note: All previously promised workflows now have an executable or explicitly scoped pattern; optional layouts remain clearly optional.

reliability.note: Executable small-k, Egger, sparse-strata, scalar-reference, and interval-bound safeguards replace prose-only advice.

performance_context.note: Focused 184-line entry point and compact usage guide; optional layouts are intentionally short.

agent_usability.note: Decision table distinguishes six easily conflated workflows and failures have actionable stops.

human_usability.note: Usage prompts and a fully runnable reference make the intended inputs explicit.

security.note: No credentials, network calls, shell execution, or user-string evaluation.

maintainability.note: One self-contained deterministic R reference and exact-commit evidence cover all primary workflows.

agent_specific.note: Specific trigger boundary, progressive workflow choice, deterministic example, and clear escape hatches.

inputs.label: REML BCG forest with log-ratio axis and prediction interval

assertions.text: Pooled BCG REML estimate equals the independently established audit value
Footer carries tau-squared, I-squared, and Q p-value
assertions.note: Rendered footer reads RE model (tau^2 = 0.338; I^2 = 92.1%; Q p = <2e-16).

assertions.text: Every study, pooled, and prediction interval lies inside the plotting range
assertions.note: Limits are derived from study CIs, pooled CI, prediction interval, and ticks; inspected PNG has no clipped-interval arrows.

assertions.text: Ratio axis is log-scaled with OR ticks and reference line 1
assertions.note: Ticks 0.25, 0.5, 1, 2, 4 and dotted reference are rendered.

assertions.text: Forest render completes without R warnings
assertions.note: Harness uses options(warn = 2) and completed.

inputs.label: Funnel, contour funnel, Egger, and trim-and-fill safeguards
inputs.execution_note: Exact harness rendered real BCG funnel; shipped example rendered contour funnel and sensitivity result.

assertions.text: Funnel reference is a scalar pooled estimate
assertions.note: Source uses as.numeric(coef(res)[1]); warning-as-error harness passed.

assertions.text: Egger is only offered at k >= 10
assertions.note: Source contract and k=3 execution confirm the explicit withholding branch.

assertions.text: Contour funnel is runnable
assertions.note: Shipped example wrote plots/funnel.pdf successfully.

assertions.text: Trim-and-fill is labelled sensitivity-only
assertions.note: Source prints original and sensitivity OR together and documents hypothetical imputations.

assertions.text: No R array-recycling warning occurs
assertions.note: options(warn = 2) exact harness completed.

inputs.label: Three-study small-k meta-analysis
inputs.execution_note: Exact harness fits the synthetic k=3 model with metafor 4.8.0.

assertions.text: Small-k model uses HKSJ
assertions.note: Exact harness confirms test == knha.

assertions.text: Small-k footer withholds I-squared
assertions.note: Footer is RE model (k = 3; HKSJ CI; heterogeneity metrics withheld).

assertions.text: Egger is withheld below ten studies
assertions.note: Exact harness confirms k=3 branch is not eligible for Egger.

assertions.text: Pooling fewer than three studies is rejected
assertions.note: Exact-source contract locates the nrow(studies) < 3 stop guard.

assertions.text: HKSJ claim is appropriately qualified
assertions.note: Source says k <= 3 remains highly imprecise and is not decisive.

inputs.label: Cox covariate forest and treatment-by-subgroup forest
inputs.execution_note: Shipped exact example generated both synthetic-Cox PDFs with a seeded data set.

assertions.text: ggforest is accurately labelled as adjusted covariate display
assertions.note: Source heading and figure title say adjusted covariate HRs.

assertions.text: Subgroup path estimates stratum treatment HRs and tests interaction
assertions.note: Source fits treatment * subgroup and records LRT p.

assertions.text: Sparse strata are stopped before estimation
assertions.note: Counts <20 and events <5 guards are present.

assertions.text: The supplied example is self-contained
assertions.note: clinical_df is constructed in the example; all Cox PDFs were written.

assertions.text: Subgroup plot and covariate plot are separate artifacts
assertions.note: cox_subgroup_forest.pdf and cox_adjusted_covariates.pdf both exist and exceed 1 KB.

inputs.label: MR method comparison with outlier-safe layout
inputs.execution_note: Shipped exact example used bundled LDL-C/CHD instruments and wrote mr_method_forest.pdf.

assertions.text: MR forest suppresses SNP rows for method comparison
assertions.note: Source and example use snp_estimates = FALSE.

assertions.text: Multiple MR methods are run
assertions.note: IVW, weighted median, mode, and Egger are passed to mr_forest.

assertions.text: MR-Egger intercept is reported
assertions.note: Exact run reports intercept -0.0115; p = 0.451.

assertions.text: Input constructor is not shadowed
assertions.note: Example stores result in mr_dat rather than mr_input.

assertions.text: MR method figure is produced
assertions.note: plots/mr_method_forest.pdf exists and exceeds 1 KB.

key_strengths: Rendered BCG forest carries a scalar heterogeneity footer and no longer clips study confidence intervals.
Small-k, Egger, sparse-subgroup, and MR-outlier guards are executable rather than prose-only.
The self-contained reference runs end-to-end through forest, funnel, Cox, and MR outputs with warnings promoted to errors.
environment_notes: The shared Windows R 4.4 audit runtime writes every expected artifact and reaches HARNESS PASS, then exits 139 during process teardown. An isolated library(survminer) probe reproduces the same post-success shutdown fault; metafor and survival probes exit 0. This is recorded as an audit-environment package/finalizer defect, not an open Skill finding.
